questionSnapshot.question: In which themed land of Magic Kingdom would you find Cinderella Castle?

notes: q779 asks the small-world boat ride’s land, a different attraction-location fact. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.

verification.context: Walt Disney World, specified park/attraction; current naming/layout at review date.

premise.reason: Disney locates the castle at the entrance/gateway to Fantasyland.

sources.locator: Opening sentence: castle at entrance to Fantasyland in Magic Kingdom Park; distinguishes Disneyland’s Sleeping Beauty Castle later in the same paragraph.
Page title and introduction identify Cinderella Castle as Magic Kingdom’s symbol; A Fairytale Come to Life locates its gateway at Fantasyland.

challenge.notes: Read the official entrance/gateway location rather than guessing from the central hub’s proximity to several lands. Both official references identify Fantasyland; geographic nearness to other lands does not make their names correct.

options.reason: Fantasyland is the land whose entrance the castle marks.
